E0904

Can't infer a type argument

What

Can't infer a type argument

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0904

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0904: tests/ui/generic_constructor_ambiguous.stderr.

Error [E0904]: `Empty.new` needs its generic receiver type here
  --> tests/ui/generic_constructor_ambiguous.jet:18:19
    |
 18 |     item :: Empty.new()
    |                   ^^^
 Why: constructor inputs and the surrounding expected type must determine one concrete receiver type
 Fix: write the full receiver, such as `Empty<T>.new(...)`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0904
